title: Soundtrack
wikitext:
[[File:Soundtrack Album Cover.png|thumb|right|Album cover for CD soundtrack. Artwork by [https://www.fangamer.com/collections/kari-fry Kari Fry]]] The '''Stardew Valley Official Soundtrack (OST)''' is composed by [[ConcernedApe]]. It's available on [https://store.steampowered.com/app/440820/Stardew_Valley_Soundtrack/ Steam] in select languages and via the [https://www.stardewvalley.net/shop/ official merchandise shop]. It's also available through multiple digital music platforms courtesy of ConcernedApe. The original soundtrack included 70 songs. Songs added to the soundtrack since then: * Four songs from v1.1 in November 2017 * Three songs from v1.3 in August 2018 * Fourteen songs from v1.4 in November 2019 * Nine songs from v1.5 in December 2020 The player can use a [[Mini-Jukebox]] on [[The Farm|the farm]], any interior of a [[:Category:Farm_buildings|building]], or [[The Cave|the cave]] to continuously play the music of their choice. Only tracks that have been heard before can be selected. ==Tracks List== For triggering conditions details, see the section below. [[File:Leo Icon.png|22px|link=Leo]] [[Leo]] at [[Leo#Two Hearts|2 ]][[File:HeartIconLarge.png|16px|link=Leo#Two Hearts]], [[Leo#Four Hearts|4 ]][[File:HeartIconLarge.png|16px|link=Leo#Four Hearts]], [[Leo#Six Hearts|6 ]][[File:HeartIconLarge.png|16px|link=Leo#Six Hearts]] and [[Leo#Nine Hearts|9 ]][[File:HeartIconLarge.png|16px|link=Leo#Nine Hearts]] |colspan="2" | - |- | 100 || Summit Celebration || 03:00 || [[The Summit#Cutscene|Summit cutscene]] |colspan="2" | - |} Note that the in-game names of songs sometimes differ slightly from the Steam and Bandcamp names listed in the table. ==Triggering Conditions== In addition to the Weather, Season and Time conditions mentioned in the table above, the soundtrack triggering rules are as follows. * '''Three seasonal tracks''' exist for each season. Only one can be played on a given day. The track will not loop when finished, but if no music is playing, the track will trigger when entering any seasonal-track area (except for Town, see below, and given the weather and time conditions are met). The same conditions apply to the Ginger Island track. * '''Some locations are silent''', always or on given conditions (cutscenes and ambient sounds apart): ** The following locations are always silent: [[Wizard's_Tower#Basement_Room|Basement Room of the Wizard]], [[The Beach|Beach]], [[Blacksmith]], [[Casino]], [[Elliott's Cabin]], [[Fish Shop]] and its [[Fish Shop#Willy's Boat|back room]], [[Ginger Island#Island_East|Jungle]], [[JojaMart]], [[Mutant Bug Lair]], [[Ginger Island#Pirate Cove|Pirate Cove]] (when empty), [[Qi's Walnut Room]], [[Quarry Mine]], [[The Sewers|Sewers]], [[Skull Cavern]] entrance, [[Spa]], [[The Tunnel|Tunnel]], [[Witch's Hut]], [[Witch's Swamp]] ** The [[Railroad]] is silent except during Winter. ** Outside areas and most stores are silent during {{Weather inline|Rain}} and {{Weather inline|Storm}} days. ** If a non-seasonal-track is playing, and the player enters a seasonal-track area ([[Pelican Town|Town]] apart), there will be silence (''e.g.,'' entering the [[Cindersap Forest|Forest]] from [[Pelican Town|Town]] when the Town theme is playing, exiting the [[Adventurer's Guild]], the [[Secret Woods]], the [[Wizard's Tower]]...). Exiting [[Treehouse]] makes an exception to the rule: the track playing before the player enters plays. * '''In [[Pelican Town]]''', music triggering works as follows: ** If the seasonal track is playing, it continues playing when entering town. ** If no track is playing and the player enters [[Pelican Town|Town]] from the [[Bus Stop]], the [[Cindersap Forest|Forest]] or [[the Mountain]], the seasonal track will be triggered if it is before 12 PM. Otherwise, the Town theme will be triggered (given other weather, season and time conditions are met). ** If the player enters [[Pelican Town|Town]] from [[the Beach]], [[the Sewers]], or by exiting the [[Blacksmith]], the [[Community Center]], [[Harvey's Clinic]], [[JojaMart]], the [[Movie Theater]] or the [[Museum]], the Town theme will be triggered (given the weather, season and time conditions are met). It will also be triggered when exiting any town building if no music was previously playing. ** The Town theme auto-loops while staying in town or one of its buildings (even after 6 PM, but the track will then abruptly stop at 7 PM if outside and at 8 PM if in a building). * '''The track will not change''', nor will be silenced, entering the following locations: ** Any interior on [[the Farm]] ([[:Category:Farm_buildings|buildings]] and the [[The Cave|cave]]), [[the Mines]] entrance, the [[Tent]] and most [[Pelican Town|Town]] houses ([[1 River Road]], [[1 Willow Lane]], [[2 Willow Lane]], [[Mayor's Manor]], [[Pierre's General Store]], [[The Stardrop Saloon|Stardrop Saloon]] before 5 PM, [[Trailer]]) ** [[Marnie's Ranch]] and [[Carpenter's Shop]]. In those, ''Country Shop'' triggers on entering only if no music was previously playing. ** [[Community Center]] on entering, but the Town theme will play after exiting. ** The [[Volcano Dungeon]] entrance, if the previous track is one of the three volcano tracks. * In '''[[The Mines]]''' and the '''[[Skull Cavern]]''', music triggering is dependent of mine level and time since music last played. On floor 2, music will always begin playing. On floors 1, 11, 40, 80, and 120, the game music will stop playing. On floors 31-39, 71-79, 111-119, and floors that are divisible by 5, the game music will continue playing but no new tracks will be played. On all remaining floors, there is a 50% chance to play a new song if it has been at least 2.5 minutes since the last song in the Mines began. Taking the elevator to a different section of the Mines will also cause the game music to stop playing. ==Trivia== *In addition to ConcernedApe's [https://concernedape.bandcamp.com/album/stardew-valley-ost official Bandcamp account], he has at least two other Bandcamp accounts: https://evergreenmultimedia.bandcamp.com/ and a secret account, that he may reveal in "another decade". ==References== The track does not play in {{Weather inline|Fallwind}}y weather in {{Season|Fall}}. During Winter, the weather can either be {{Weather inline|Sun}} or {{Weather inline|Snow}} (no rain, no storm, no wind). This track can be played during either of those two. The same notes are used for the [[Ginger Island#Mermaid|Ginger Island's Mermaid]]. See MineShaft::getMineSong in the decompiled game code, and the [[Talk:Soundtrack]] page.
